limitations: Uniform effective rates by route do not explain concurrency-conditioned dominant transfers.
Unknown SSH/cache waiting and CPU/IO contention remain in wall coefficients; rates are not queue-free network bandwidth.
Explicit SSH groups are disabled in this sensitivity to avoid adding admission twice; simulated network sharing can still overlap observed sharing.
Logical output bytes are not whole workspace bytes; calibration uses preserved source workspace sizeBytes.
Replanned placement is slower than frozen-placement native simulation; planner optimality is not established.
A longer makespan alone does not prove a more faithful model; the per-activity gate worsened.
